description: Extract decisions, patterns, error fixes, and conventions from a session transcript using heuristic analysis. Deduplicates against existing memories and optionally auto-stores.

auto_store.description: If true, automatically store extracted learnings as memories

categories.description: Which categories of learnings to extract (default: all)

department.description: Department (e.g., legal, engineering, hr, sales, finance)

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

transcript.description: Session transcript or conversation text to extract learnings from

name: memory_extract_learnings
